news.headline: Seven things Solak thinks entering NFL Week 4
news.description: Bowers will go off under Klint Kubiak? The Rams need another pass catcher? Steelers-Browns will be fun? And Lamar Jackson for MVP? Get ready for Week 4 with some takes.

news.headline: What has gone wrong for the Patriots' offense, Drake Maye?
news.description: New England is last in the NFL in offensive points per game at 9.7. Can Maye and his supporting cast settle things down and turn it around?

news.headline: Bears call on QB3 Case Keenum in rousing victory over Eagles
news.description: In his first NFL start in 1,009 days, Chicago third-string quarterback Case Keenum, 38, led the Bears to a dominant 27-7 victory over the perennial NFC heavyweight Philadelphia Eagles on Monday, a performance coach Ben Johnson labeled "extraordinary."

news.headline: Sirianni regrets reaction to hit on QB Hurts in Eagles' loss
news.description: After a 27-7 loss to Chicago on Monday, Eagles coach Nick Sirianni expressed "remorse" over his reaction to a sideline hit by Bears linebacker D'Marco Jackson on Philadelphia's Jalen Hurts that temporarily knocked his quarterback out of the first half.

news.headline: Seahawks' Mike Macdonald says team still believes in RB Jadarian Price
news.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said the team has not lost faith in starting running back Jadarian Price after the rookie first-round pick lost a fumble for the second week in a row Sunday.

news.headline: McVay, Rams won't make excuses after pass interference call
news.description: A day after his team's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos, Los Angeles coach Sean McVay said the 1-2 Rams will not "play the victim card" because of a debatable defensive pass interference late on cornerback Josh Wallace.
